application_conditions: Application via the 'Affiliate Application' link, reviewed by Gemini. Named audiences: influencers / content creators / community leaders, Gemini users, organisations 'whose values align'. Other criteria not published.
paid_action: '$25 per converted account' when a new user 'places a trade'. The Gemini Credit Card is not named as a paid action; the credit-card referral terms explicitly exclude 'marketing affiliates' from the $50 cardholder referral offer.
validation_conditions: New user must place a trade. Window and other conditions not stated.

commission.model_note: Flat CPA: $25 per converted (trading) account. No card-specific payout found.

rules_note: Performance tracked 'via the Impact platform' (consistent with the Impact sjv.io link seen on crypto.news during discovery). No programme terms document linked from the article. A separate cardholder-only referral programme pays $50 per referred friend (max 50/year, $5,000/year) — not usable by a publisher.
allowed_countries_note: Not stated. The credit card itself is US-only.

evidence.title: Does Gemini have an Affiliate program? (support centre)
evidence.excerpt: $25 per converted account when a new user places a trade; Impact tracking; application reviewed by Gemini.

evidence.title: Gemini Credit Card Referral Program Terms (December 19, 2025)
evidence.excerpt: Cardholder referral: $50 referrer / $50 referee, $250 bonus at the 5th referral, max 50 referrals and $5,000 per year; 'Gemini Credit Card marketing affiliates are not eligible to participate'.

notes: Publisher programme exists (CPA on trading accounts) but does not pay on the credit card. Decision for David: whether a US-only trading CPA fits the comparator at all. No application made.
